segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Le concept du jour

segments.src: Think of soil as a checking account that plants draw from every day.
segments.tr: Considérez le sol comme un compte courant dans lequel les plantes puisent chaque jour.

segments.src: Plants build themselves out of **essential elements** — nutrients that, if missing, mean the plant literally cannot complete its life cycle.
segments.tr: Les plantes se construisent à partir d'**éléments essentiels** — des nutriments qui, s'ils sont absents, empêchent littéralement la plante de terminer son cycle de vie.

segments.src: There are 17 of them.
segments.tr: Il y en a 17.

segments.src: Three come free from air and water: carbon, hydrogen, oxygen.
segments.tr: Trois sont fournis gratuitement par l'air et l'eau : le carbone, l'hydrogène et l'oxygène.

segments.src: The other 14 come from the soil.
segments.tr: Les 14 autres proviennent du sol.

segments.src: Those 14 split into two groups by *quantity needed*, not importance:
segments.tr: Ces 14 éléments se divisent en deux groupes selon la *quantité nécessaire*, et non selon leur importance :

segments.src: - **Macronutrients** (needed in large amounts): nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), plus calcium, magnesium, and sulfur.
segments.tr: - **Macronutriments** (nécessaires en grandes quantités) : azote (N), phosphore (P), potassium (K), ainsi que calcium, magnésium et soufre.

segments.src: - **Micronutrients** (needed in trace amounts): iron, manganese, zinc, copper, boron, molybdenum, chlorine, nickel.
segments.tr: - **Micronutriments** (nécessaires en quantités infimes) : fer, manganèse, zinc, cuivre, bore, molybdène, chlore, nickel.

segments.src: A micronutrient deficiency will kill a crop just as dead as a nitrogen shortage.
segments.tr: Une carence en micronutriments tuera une culture tout aussi sûrement qu'une pénurie d'azote.

segments.src: The difference is how much you have to add.
segments.tr: La différence réside dans la quantité que vous devez ajouter.

segments.tr: **Le trio gagnant.** Chaque sac d'engrais aux États-Unis

segments.src: carries three numbers on the front — say, `10-10-10`.
segments.tr: porte trois chiffres sur le devant — par exemple, `10-10-10`.

segments.tr: C'est l'analyse garantie : pourcentage d'azote, pourcentage de phosphate (P₂O₅), pourcentage de potasse (K₂O), en poids.

segments.src: Roughly what each does:
segments.tr: En gros, voici le rôle de chacun :

segments.src: - **Nitrogen** — leaves and stems, chlorophyll, protein. Deficiency shows as pale yellowing on the *oldest* leaves first, because the plant scavenges N from old tissue and moves it to new growth.
segments.tr: - **Azote** — feuilles et tiges, chlorophylle, protéines. La carence se manifeste d'abord par un jaunissement pâle sur les feuilles les *plus anciennes*, car la plante récupère l'azote des vieux tissus pour le transférer vers les nouvelles pousses.

segments.tr: - **Phosphore** — racines, transfert d'énergie, floraison et formation des graines. La carence peut se manifester par des feuilles ternes aux reflets violets.

segments.tr: - **Potassium** — régulation de l'eau, contrôle des stomates, résistance aux maladies, solidité des tiges. La carence se manifeste souvent par des bords de feuilles brûlés.

segments.src: **Now the part most people skip: pH.**
segments.tr: **Maintenant, la partie que la plupart des gens ignorent : le pH.**

segments.src: Soil pH is a measure of how acidic or alkaline the soil solution is, on a 0–14 scale where 7 is neutral.
segments.tr: Le pH du sol est une mesure de l'acidité ou de l'alcalinité de la solution du sol, sur une échelle de 0 à 14 où 7 est neutre.

segments.src: It matters because **pH controls nutrient availability**.

segments.src: Phosphorus is most available roughly between pH 6.0 and 7.0 — which is why most field crops and garden vegetables are happiest in the pH 6.0–7.0 window.
segments.tr: Le phosphore est le plus disponible approximativement entre un pH de 6,0 et 7,0 — c'est pourquoi la plupart des grandes cultures et des légumes de jardin se portent mieux dans la fourchette de pH 6,0–7,0.

segments.src: Iron, manganese, and zinc run the opposite way: they get *more* available as soil turns acidic.
segments.tr: Le fer, le manganèse et le zinc fonctionnent à l'inverse : ils deviennent *plus* disponibles à mesure que le sol devient acide.

segments.src: That's why azaleas and blueberries — acid-lovers — go chlorotic and yellow in alkaline soil.

segments.src: That resistance is buffering, and it comes from the soil's reserve of exchangeable acidity sitting on clay particles and organic matter — a large hidden pool that keeps refilling the soil solution as you neutralize it.

segments.src: Practical consequence: a heavy clay soil rich in organic matter needs *far more* lime to raise its pH one unit than a sandy soil does.

segments.src: High CEC means a soil holds a large nutrient reserve and buffers strongly.
segments.tr: Une CEC élevée signifie qu'un sol détient une grande réserve de nutriments et possède un fort pouvoir tampon.

segments.src: Low CEC (sandy soil) means nutrients leach through fast.
segments.tr: Une CEC faible (sol sableux) signifie que les nutriments sont lessivés rapidement.

segments.src: Same fertilizer, very different behavior.
segments.tr: Même engrais, comportement très différent.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Say you're in Ohio and you plant tomatoes in the same backyard bed for the third summer running.
segments.tr: Supposons que vous soyez dans l'Ohio et que vous plantiez des tomates dans le même carré de jardin pour le troisième été consécutif.

segments.src: You fertilize religiously with a high-nitrogen lawn-style product because it's what's in the garage.
segments.tr: Vous fertilisez religieusement avec un produit riche en azote pour pelouse parce que c'est ce qu'il y a dans le garage.

segments.src: You get magnificent, dark green, four-foot vines — and almost no fruit.
segments.tr: Vous obtenez de magnifiques vignes vert foncé d'un mètre vingt — et presque pas de fruits.

segments.src: That's textbook nutrient imbalance.
segments.tr: C'est un cas d'école de déséquilibre nutritionnel.

segments.src: Excess nitrogen pushes vegetative growth at the expense of flowering and fruit set.
segments.tr: Un excès d'azote favorise la croissance végétative au détriment de la floraison et de la nouaison.

segments.src: Meanwhile, three seasons of removing tomatoes has been quietly withdrawing potassium and phosphorus from the account with no matching deposit.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, trois saisons de récolte de tomates ont tranquillement retiré du potassium et du phosphore du compte sans dépôt correspondant.

segments.src: And in much of the eastern U.S., where rainfall gradually leaches calcium and magnesium out of the topsoil, the pH has been drifting downward year over year — possibly into the mid-5s, where phosphorus availability drops sharply.
segments.tr: Et dans une grande partie de l'est des États-Unis, où les précipitations lessivent progressivement le calcium et le magnésium de la couche arable, le pH a dérivé vers le bas année après année — peut-être vers le milieu des 5, où la disponibilité du phosphore chute brutalement.

segments.src: The fix costs less than a bag of fertilizer.
segments.tr: La solution coûte moins cher qu'un sac d'engrais.

segments.src: Nearly every state has a land-grant university extension service — Ohio State, Penn State, NC State, Texas A&M — running soil testing labs, typically in the $15–$25 range per sample.
segments.tr: Presque chaque État dispose d'un service de vulgarisation universitaire (land-grant university) — Ohio State, Penn State, NC State, Texas A&M — qui gère des laboratoires d'analyse de sol, généralement dans une fourchette de 15 à 25 $ par échantillon.

segments.src: You send in a composite of 10–15 cores from around the bed.
segments.tr: Vous envoyez un échantillon composite de 10 à 15 carottes prélevées autour du carré.

segments.src: What comes back is pH, buffer pH, extractable P and K, calcium, magnesium, organic matter percentage, and CEC, plus a recommendation in pounds per 1,000 square feet.
segments.tr: Ce qui vous revient est le pH, le pH tampon, le P et K extractibles, le calcium, le magnésium, le pourcentage de matière organique et la CEC, ainsi qu'une recommandation en livres par 1 000 pieds carrés.

segments.src: If the report says pH 5.4 with a lime requirement of 50 lb per 1,000 sq ft, spreading that lime the previous fall will do more for next year's tomatoes than any amount of fertilizer applied in June.
segments.tr: Si le rapport indique un pH de 5,4 avec un besoin en chaux de 50 lb par 1 000 pieds carrés, épandre cette chaux à l'automne précédent fera plus pour les tomates de l'année prochaine que n'importe quelle quantité d'engrais appliquée en juin.

segments.src: You're not adding nutrients — you're unlocking the ones already sitting there.
segments.tr: Vous n'ajoutez pas de nutriments — vous débloquez ceux qui sont déjà là.

segments.src: There's an environmental side too.
segments.tr: Il y a aussi un aspect environnemental.

segments.src: Nutrients you apply beyond what the crop can use don't vanish.
segments.tr: Les nutriments que vous appliquez au-delà de ce que la culture peut utiliser ne disparaissent pas.

segments.src: Nitrate leaches into groundwater; phosphorus runs off into surface water and feeds algal blooms.
segments.tr: Le nitrate se lessive dans les eaux souterraines ; le phosphore ruisselle dans les eaux de surface et alimente les proliférations d'algues.

segments.src: The recurring summer blooms in Lake Erie and the hypoxic "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico are both driven substantially by nutrient runoff from a very large watershed.
segments.tr: Les proliférations estivales récurrentes dans le lac Érié et la « zone morte » hypoxique dans le golfe du Mexique sont toutes deux largement causées par le ruissellement des nutriments provenant d'un très grand bassin versant.

segments.src: Matching the rate to the actual soil test is the single cheapest thing that helps both your yield and the water downstream.
segments.tr: Adapter le taux à l'analyse de sol réelle est la chose la plus simple et la moins coûteuse qui aide à la fois votre rendement et l'eau en aval.

segments.src: The professional framing for this is the **4Rs**: Right source, Right rate, Right time, Right place.
segments.tr: Le cadre professionnel pour cela est celui des **4R** : Bonne source, Bon taux, Bon moment, Bon endroit.

segments.src: Pick the fertilizer form that fits, apply only what the test calls for, put it down when the crop can use it, and place it where roots will find it.
segments.tr: Choisissez la forme d'engrais qui convient, appliquez uniquement ce que l'analyse demande, épandez-le lorsque la culture peut l'utiliser et placez-le là où les racines le trouveront.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Résumé en 3 points

segments.src: 1. Plants need 17 essential elements; N, P, and K are needed in the largest amounts, which is why every fertilizer bag carries three numbers (`N-P₂O₅-K₂O`) on the front.
segments.tr: 1. Les plantes ont besoin de 17 éléments essentiels ; N, P et K sont nécessaires en plus grandes quantités, c'est pourquoi chaque sac d'engrais porte trois chiffres (`N-P₂O₅-K₂O`) sur le devant.

segments.src: 2. Soil pH governs whether nutrients are chemically *available* to roots — phosphorus peaks around pH 6.0–7.0, while iron and zinc become more available as soil turns acidic.
segments.tr: 2. Le pH du sol régit la *disponibilité* chimique des nutriments pour les racines — le phosphore culmine autour d'un pH de 6,0–7,0, tandis que le fer et le zinc deviennent plus disponibles à mesure que le sol devient acide.

segments.src: 3. Buffering capacity, driven by clay and organic matter, resists pH change — so a soil test's buffer pH, not the pH alone, tells you how much lime to apply.
segments.tr: 3. La capacité tampon, due à l'argile et à la matière organique, résiste au changement de pH — donc le pH tampon d'une analyse de sol, et non le pH seul, vous indique quelle quantité de chaux appliquer.

segments.tr: Combien de livres de phosphate réel (P₂O₅) contient-il ?

segments.tr: - B) 10 lb

segments.tr: - C) 20 lb

segments.tr: - D) 50 lb

segments.tr: **Q2.** V/F — Deux sols ont tous deux un pH de 5,5, ils auront donc tous deux besoin de la même quantité de chaux pour atteindre un pH de 6,5.

segments.tr: **Q3.** Le sol d'un jardinier contient beaucoup de fer, mais les plantes présentent un jaunissement entre les nervures des feuilles (chlorose).

segments.tr: Quelle condition est la cause la plus probable ?

segments.tr: - A) Le pH du sol est trop bas (fortement acide)

segments.tr: - B) Le pH du sol est trop élevé (alcalin)

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Glossaire du jour

segments.src: - **Essential element** — A nutrient a plant cannot complete its life cycle without, and whose role no other element can substitute for; there are 17.
segments.tr: - **Élément essentiel** — Un nutriment sans lequel une plante ne peut pas terminer son cycle de vie, et dont aucun autre élément ne peut remplacer le rôle ; il y en a 17.

segments.src: - **Macronutrient / Micronutrient** — Classification by the *amount* a plant needs, not by importance; both categories are equally essential.
segments.tr: - **Macronutriment / Micronutriment** — Classification selon la *quantité* dont une plante a besoin, et non selon l'importance ; les deux catégories sont tout aussi essentielles.

segments.src: - **Guaranteed analysis (N-P-K)** — The three numbers on a fertilizer label giving percent nitrogen, percent phosphate (P₂O₅), and percent potash (K₂O) by weight.
segments.tr: - **Analyse garantie (N-P-K)** — Les trois chiffres sur une étiquette d'engrais indiquant le pourcentage d'azote, le pourcentage de phosphate (P₂O₅) et le pourcentage de potasse (K₂O) en poids.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — The acidity or alkalinity of the soil solution on a 0–14 scale; it determines the chemical form, and therefore the availability, of most nutrients.
segments.tr: - **pH du sol** — L'acidité ou l'alcalinité de la solution du sol sur une échelle de 0 à 14 ; il détermine la forme chimique, et donc la disponibilité, de la plupart des nutriments.

segments.src: - **Buffering capacity** — A soil's resistance to pH change, supplied by exchangeable acidity held on clay and organic matter; it sets how much lime or sulfur is actually required.
segments.tr: - **Capacité tampon** — La résistance d'un sol au changement de pH, fournie par l'acidité échangeable retenue sur l'argile et la matière organique ; elle détermine la quantité de chaux ou de soufre réellement nécessaire.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's total capacity to hold positively charged nutrients on negatively charged clay and organic matter surfaces; a proxy for nutrient-holding ability.
segments.tr: - **Capacité d'échange cationique (CEC)** — La capacité totale du sol à retenir les nutriments chargés positivement sur les surfaces d'argile et de matière organique chargées négativement ; un indicateur de la capacité de rétention des nutriments.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 → B (10 lb).** The middle number is percent by weight, so 20% of 50 lb = 10 lb of phosphate.
segments.tr: *Réponse : **Q1 → B (10 lb).** Le chiffre du milieu est le pourcentage en poids, donc 20 % de 50 lb = 10 lb de phosphate.

segments.src: Note this is P₂O₅, the oxide form used on labels, not elemental phosphorus — elemental P would be about 44% of that figure.*
segments.tr: Notez qu'il s'agit de P₂O₅, la forme oxyde utilisée sur les étiquettes, et non de phosphore élémentaire — le P élémentaire représenterait environ 44 % de ce chiffre.*

segments.src: ***Q2 → X (False).** Identical pH does not mean identical lime requirement.
segments.tr: ***Q2 → F (Faux).** Un pH identique ne signifie pas un besoin en chaux identique.

segments.src: A heavy clay soil high in organic matter has a large reserve of exchangeable acidity — high buffering — and may need several times the lime a sandy soil needs to make the same pH move.
segments.tr: Un sol argileux lourd riche en matière organique possède une grande réserve d'acidité échangeable — un pouvoir tampon élevé — et peut nécessiter plusieurs fois la quantité de chaux qu'un sol sableux pour obtenir le même changement de pH.

segments.src: This is exactly why soil test reports include a buffer pH.*
segments.tr: C'est exactement pourquoi les rapports d'analyse de sol incluent un pH tampon.*

segments.src: ***Q3 → B.** Iron becomes progressively less soluble as pH rises; in alkaline soil it precipitates into forms roots cannot absorb.
segments.tr: ***Q3 → B.** Le fer devient progressivement moins soluble à mesure que le pH augmente ; dans un sol alcalin, il précipite sous des formes que les racines ne peuvent pas absorber.

segments.src: The plant is iron-deficient despite iron being physically present — a good illustration that total nutrient content and plant-available nutrient content are two different things.
segments.tr: La plante est carencée en fer bien que le fer soit physiquement présent — une bonne illustration du fait que la teneur totale en nutriments et la teneur en nutriments disponibles pour la plante sont deux choses différentes.

segments.src: Interveinal chlorosis on the youngest leaves is the classic symptom, because iron is not readily remobilized within the plant.*
segments.tr: La chlorose internervaire sur les feuilles les plus jeunes est le symptôme classique, car le fer n'est pas facilement remobilisé au sein de la plante.*

pt.title: [Agricultura 101 #4] Seu solo é uma conta bancária — veja como funcionam os depósitos e saques

segments.src: > Plants need 17 essential elements, but three of them (N, P, K) do most of the heavy lifting — and soil pH quietly decides how much of any of them a root can actually reach.
segments.tr: > As plantas precisam de 17 elementos essenciais, mas três deles (N, P, K) fazem a maior parte do trabalho pesado — e o pH do solo decide silenciosamente quanto de cada um deles uma raiz pode realmente alcançar.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Conceitos de hoje

segments.src: Think of soil as a checking account that plants draw from every day.
segments.tr: Pense no solo como uma conta corrente da qual as plantas retiram recursos todos os dias.

segments.src: Plants build themselves out of **essential elements** — nutrients that, if missing, mean the plant literally cannot complete its life cycle.
segments.tr: As plantas se constroem a partir de **elementos essenciais** — nutrientes que, se faltarem, significam que a planta literalmente não consegue completar seu ciclo de vida.

segments.src: There are 17 of them.
segments.tr: Existem 17 deles.

segments.src: Three come free from air and water: carbon, hydrogen, oxygen.
segments.tr: Três vêm de graça do ar e da água: carbono, hidrogênio, oxigênio.

segments.src: The other 14 come from the soil.
segments.tr: Os outros 14 vêm do solo.

segments.src: Those 14 split into two groups by *quantity needed*, not importance:
segments.tr: Esses 14 se dividem em dois grupos pela *quantidade necessária*, não pela importância:

segments.src: - **Macronutrients** (needed in large amounts): nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), plus calcium, magnesium, and sulfur.
segments.tr: - **Macronutrientes** (necessários em grandes quantidades): nitrogênio (N), fósforo (P), potássio (K), além de cálcio, magnésio e enxofre.

segments.src: - **Micronutrients** (needed in trace amounts): iron, manganese, zinc, copper, boron, molybdenum, chlorine, nickel.
segments.tr: - **Micronutrientes** (necessários em quantidades vestigiais): ferro, manganês, zinco, cobre, boro, molibdênio, cloro, níquel.

segments.src: A micronutrient deficiency will kill a crop just as dead as a nitrogen shortage.
segments.tr: Uma deficiência de micronutrientes matará uma cultura tão certamente quanto a falta de nitrogênio.

segments.src: The difference is how much you have to add.
segments.tr: A diferença é a quantidade que você precisa adicionar.

segments.src: **The Big Three.** Every bag of fertilizer in the U.S.
segments.tr: **Os Três Grandes.** Cada saco de fertilizante nos EUA

segments.src: carries three numbers on the front — say, `10-10-10`.
segments.tr: traz três números na frente — digamos, `10-10-10`.

segments.src: That's the guaranteed analysis: percent nitrogen, percent phosphate (P₂O₅), percent potash (K₂O), by weight.
segments.tr: Essa é a análise garantida: porcentagem de nitrogênio, porcentagem de fosfato (P₂O₅), porcentagem de potássio (K₂O), por peso.

segments.src: A 50 lb bag of 10-10-10 contains 5 lb of N, 5 lb of phosphate, and 5 lb of potash.
segments.tr: Um saco de 50 lb de 10-10-10 contém 5 lb de N, 5 lb de fosfato e 5 lb de potássio.

segments.src: The rest is carrier and filler.
segments.tr: O restante é veículo e enchimento.

segments.src: Roughly what each does:
segments.tr: Basicamente o que cada um faz:

segments.src: - **Nitrogen** — leaves and stems, chlorophyll, protein. Deficiency shows as pale yellowing on the *oldest* leaves first, because the plant scavenges N from old tissue and moves it to new growth.
segments.tr: - **Nitrogênio** — folhas e caules, clorofila, proteína. A deficiência aparece como um amarelamento pálido primeiro nas folhas *mais velhas*, porque a planta retira N do tecido antigo e o move para o novo crescimento.

segments.src: - **Phosphorus** — roots, energy transfer, flowering and seed set. Deficiency can show as dull purple-tinged leaves.
segments.tr: - **Fósforo** — raízes, transferência de energia, floração e formação de sementes. A deficiência pode aparecer como folhas com tons roxos opacos.

segments.src: - **Potassium** — water regulation, stomatal control, disease resistance, stalk strength. Deficiency often shows as scorched leaf margins.
segments.tr: - **Potássio** — regulação hídrica, controle estomático, resistência a doenças, força do caule. A deficiência geralmente aparece como margens das folhas queimadas.

segments.src: **Now the part most people skip: pH.**
segments.tr: **Agora a parte que a maioria das pessoas pula: pH.**

segments.src: Soil pH is a measure of how acidic or alkaline the soil solution is, on a 0–14 scale where 7 is neutral.
segments.tr: O pH do solo é uma medida de quão ácida ou alcalina é a solução do solo, em uma escala de 0 a 14, onde 7 é neutro.

segments.src: It matters because **pH controls nutrient availability**.
segments.tr: Isso importa porque o **pH controla a disponibilidade de nutrientes**.

segments.src: You can have plenty of phosphorus in the soil and still starve the crop, because at low pH the phosphorus binds with iron and aluminum into forms roots can't take up.
segments.tr: Você pode ter muito fósforo no solo e ainda assim deixar a cultura passar fome, porque em pH baixo o fósforo se liga ao ferro e ao alumínio em formas que as raízes não conseguem absorver.

segments.src: At high pH it binds with calcium instead.
segments.tr: Em pH alto, ele se liga ao cálcio.

segments.src: Phosphorus is most available roughly between pH 6.0 and 7.0 — which is why most field crops and garden vegetables are happiest in the pH 6.0–7.0 window.
segments.tr: O fósforo está mais disponível aproximadamente entre pH 6,0 e 7,0 — é por isso que a maioria das culturas de campo e vegetais de jardim ficam mais felizes na faixa de pH 6,0–7,0.

segments.src: Iron, manganese, and zinc run the opposite way: they get *more* available as soil turns acidic.
segments.tr: Ferro, manganês e zinco funcionam de forma oposta: eles ficam *mais* disponíveis à medida que o solo se torna ácido.

segments.src: That's why azaleas and blueberries — acid-lovers — go chlorotic and yellow in alkaline soil.
segments.tr: É por isso que azaleias e mirtilos — que amam acidez — ficam cloróticos e amarelos em solo alcalino.

segments.src: They can't get iron.
segments.tr: Eles não conseguem obter ferro.

segments.src: **Buffering capacity** is why fixing pH is harder than it sounds.
segments.tr: **Capacidade de tamponamento** é o motivo pelo qual corrigir o pH é mais difícil do que parece.

segments.src: If you add acid to distilled water, the pH plunges.
segments.tr: Se você adicionar ácido à água destilada, o pH despenca.

segments.src: Add the same acid to soil and it barely moves.
segments.tr: Adicione o mesmo ácido ao solo e ele quase não muda.

segments.src: That resistance is buffering, and it comes from the soil's reserve of exchangeable acidity sitting on clay particles and organic matter — a large hidden pool that keeps refilling the soil solution as you neutralize it.
segments.tr: Essa resistência é o tamponamento, e vem da reserva de acidez trocável do solo presente nas partículas de argila e matéria orgânica — um grande reservatório oculto que continua reabastecendo a solução do solo à medida que você a neutraliza.

segments.src: Practical consequence: a heavy clay soil rich in organic matter needs *far more* lime to raise its pH one unit than a sandy soil does.
segments.tr: Consequência prática: um solo argiloso pesado e rico em matéria orgânica precisa de *muito mais* calcário para elevar seu pH em uma unidade do que um solo arenoso.

segments.src: That's why a soil test doesn't just report pH — it reports a **buffer pH** or **lime requirement**, which is the number that actually tells you how much lime to spread.
segments.tr: É por isso que um teste de solo não relata apenas o pH — ele relata um **pH tamponado** ou **necessidade de calcário**, que é o número que realmente lhe diz quanto calcário espalhar.

segments.src: Soil test pH   -> where you are now
segments.tr: Soil test pH   -> where you are now

segments.src: Buffer pH      -> how hard it will be to move
segments.tr: Buffer pH      -> how hard it will be to move

segments.src: Lime rate      -> tons per acre to get where you want
segments.tr: Lime rate      -> tons per acre to get where you want

segments.src: The general rules of thumb: **lime** (calcium carbonate) raises pH; **elemental sulfur** lowers it.
segments.tr: As regras gerais: **calcário** (carbonato de cálcio) eleva o pH; **enxofre elementar** o reduz.

segments.src: Both work slowly — months, sometimes a full season — because they depend on soil moisture, temperature, and microbial activity.
segments.tr: Ambos funcionam lentamente — meses, às vezes uma estação inteira — porque dependem da umidade do solo, temperatura e atividade microbiana.

segments.src: One more piece of vocabulary that ties it together: **cation exchange capacity (CEC)**.
segments.tr: Mais um termo de vocabulário que conecta tudo: **capacidade de troca catiônica (CTC)**.

segments.src: Clay and organic matter carry negative charges, and positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — stick to those sites like magnets on a fridge.
segments.tr: A argila e a matéria orgânica carregam cargas negativas, e nutrientes carregados positivamente — cálcio, magnésio, potássio, amônio — aderem a esses locais como ímãs em uma geladeira.

segments.src: High CEC means a soil holds a large nutrient reserve and buffers strongly.
segments.tr: Uma CTC alta significa que o solo retém uma grande reserva de nutrientes e tampona fortemente.

segments.src: Low CEC (sandy soil) means nutrients leach through fast.
segments.tr: Uma CTC baixa (solo arenoso) significa que os nutrientes lixiviam rapidamente.

segments.src: Same fertilizer, very different behavior.
segments.tr: Mesmo fertilizante, comportamento muito diferente.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## No dia a dia

segments.src: Say you're in Ohio and you plant tomatoes in the same backyard bed for the third summer running.
segments.tr: Digamos que você esteja em Ohio e plante tomates no mesmo canteiro do quintal pelo terceiro verão consecutivo.

segments.src: You fertilize religiously with a high-nitrogen lawn-style product because it's what's in the garage.
segments.tr: Você fertiliza religiosamente com um produto de alto nitrogênio estilo gramado porque é o que está na garagem.

segments.src: You get magnificent, dark green, four-foot vines — and almost no fruit.
segments.tr: Você obtém vinhas magníficas, verde-escuras, de um metro e vinte — e quase nenhuma fruta.

segments.src: That's textbook nutrient imbalance.
segments.tr: Isso é um desequilíbrio nutricional clássico.

segments.src: Excess nitrogen pushes vegetative growth at the expense of flowering and fruit set.
segments.tr: O excesso de nitrogênio impulsiona o crescimento vegetativo em detrimento da floração e da frutificação.

segments.src: Meanwhile, three seasons of removing tomatoes has been quietly withdrawing potassium and phosphorus from the account with no matching deposit.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, três temporadas removendo tomates têm retirado silenciosamente potássio e fósforo da conta sem nenhum depósito correspondente.

segments.src: And in much of the eastern U.S., where rainfall gradually leaches calcium and magnesium out of the topsoil, the pH has been drifting downward year over year — possibly into the mid-5s, where phosphorus availability drops sharply.
segments.tr: E em grande parte do leste dos EUA, onde a chuva lixivia gradualmente o cálcio e o magnésio da camada superficial do solo, o pH tem caído ano após ano — possivelmente para a casa dos 5,5, onde a disponibilidade de fósforo cai drasticamente.

segments.src: The fix costs less than a bag of fertilizer.
segments.tr: A solução custa menos que um saco de fertilizante.

segments.src: Nearly every state has a land-grant university extension service — Ohio State, Penn State, NC State, Texas A&M — running soil testing labs, typically in the $15–$25 range per sample.
segments.tr: Quase todos os estados têm um serviço de extensão universitária — Ohio State, Penn State, NC State, Texas A&M — que opera laboratórios de análise de solo, normalmente na faixa de US$ 15 a US$ 25 por amostra.

segments.src: You send in a composite of 10–15 cores from around the bed.
segments.tr: Você envia um composto de 10 a 15 amostras do canteiro.

segments.src: What comes back is pH, buffer pH, extractable P and K, calcium, magnesium, organic matter percentage, and CEC, plus a recommendation in pounds per 1,000 square feet.
segments.tr: O que retorna é o pH, pH tamponado, P e K extraíveis, cálcio, magnésio, porcentagem de matéria orgânica e CTC, além de uma recomendação em libras por 1.000 pés quadrados.

segments.src: If the report says pH 5.4 with a lime requirement of 50 lb per 1,000 sq ft, spreading that lime the previous fall will do more for next year's tomatoes than any amount of fertilizer applied in June.
segments.tr: Se o relatório diz pH 5,4 com uma necessidade de calcário de 50 lb por 1.000 pés quadrados, espalhar esse calcário no outono anterior fará mais pelos tomates do próximo ano do que qualquer quantidade de fertilizante aplicada em junho.

segments.src: You're not adding nutrients — you're unlocking the ones already sitting there.
segments.tr: Você não está adicionando nutrientes — você está desbloqueando os que já estão lá.

segments.src: There's an environmental side too.
segments.tr: Há também um lado ambiental.

segments.src: Nutrients you apply beyond what the crop can use don't vanish.
segments.tr: Nutrientes que você aplica além do que a cultura pode usar não desaparecem.

segments.src: Nitrate leaches into groundwater; phosphorus runs off into surface water and feeds algal blooms.
segments.tr: O nitrato lixivia para o lençol freático; o fósforo escoa para a água superficial e alimenta a proliferação de algas.

segments.src: The recurring summer blooms in Lake Erie and the hypoxic "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico are both driven substantially by nutrient runoff from a very large watershed.
segments.tr: As proliferações recorrentes de verão no Lago Erie e a "zona morta" hipóxica no Golfo do México são impulsionadas substancialmente pelo escoamento de nutrientes de uma bacia hidrográfica muito grande.

segments.src: Matching the rate to the actual soil test is the single cheapest thing that helps both your yield and the water downstream.
segments.tr: Combinar a taxa com o teste de solo real é a coisa mais barata que ajuda tanto seu rendimento quanto a água a jusante.

segments.src: The professional framing for this is the **4Rs**: Right source, Right rate, Right time, Right place.
segments.tr: A estrutura profissional para isso são os **4Cs**: Certo produto, Certa taxa, Certo momento, Certo local.

segments.src: Pick the fertilizer form that fits, apply only what the test calls for, put it down when the crop can use it, and place it where roots will find it.
segments.tr: Escolha a forma de fertilizante que se adapta, aplique apenas o que o teste pede, coloque-o quando a cultura puder usá-lo e coloque-o onde as raízes o encontrarão.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Resumo em 3 pontos

segments.src: 1. Plants need 17 essential elements; N, P, and K are needed in the largest amounts, which is why every fertilizer bag carries three numbers (`N-P₂O₅-K₂O`) on the front.
segments.tr: 1. As plantas precisam de 17 elementos essenciais; N, P e K são necessários nas maiores quantidades, e é por isso que cada saco de fertilizante traz três números (`N-P₂O₅-K₂O`) na frente.

segments.src: 2. Soil pH governs whether nutrients are chemically *available* to roots — phosphorus peaks around pH 6.0–7.0, while iron and zinc become more available as soil turns acidic.
segments.tr: 2. O pH do solo rege se os nutrientes estão quimicamente *disponíveis* para as raízes — o fósforo atinge o pico em torno de pH 6,0–7,0, enquanto o ferro e o zinco tornam-se mais disponíveis à medida que o solo se torna ácido.

segments.src: 3. Buffering capacity, driven by clay and organic matter, resists pH change — so a soil test's buffer pH, not the pH alone, tells you how much lime to apply.
segments.tr: 3. A capacidade de tamponamento, impulsionada pela argila e matéria orgânica, resiste à mudança de pH — portanto, o pH tamponado do teste de solo, e não apenas o pH, diz quanto calcário aplicar.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Auto-teste

segments.src: **Q1.** A 50 lb bag of fertilizer is labeled `10-20-10`.
segments.tr: **Q1.** Um saco de 50 lb de fertilizante está rotulado como `10-20-10`.

segments.src: How many pounds of actual phosphate (P₂O₅) does it contain?
segments.tr: Quantas libras de fosfato real (P₂O₅) ele contém?

segments.src: - A) 5 lb
segments.tr: - A) 5 lb

segments.src: - B) 10 lb
segments.tr: - B) 10 lb

segments.src: - C) 20 lb
segments.tr: - C) 20 lb

segments.src: - D) 50 lb
segments.tr: - D) 50 lb

segments.src: **Q2.** O/X — Two soils both test at pH 5.5, so they will both need the same amount of lime to reach pH 6.5.
segments.tr: **Q2.** V/F — Dois solos testam ambos com pH 5,5, então ambos precisarão da mesma quantidade de calcário para atingir pH 6,5.

segments.src: **Q3.** A gardener's soil has plenty of iron in it, but the plants show yellowing between the leaf veins (chlorosis).
segments.tr: **Q3.** O solo de um jardineiro tem muito ferro, mas as plantas mostram amarelamento entre as nervuras das folhas (clorose).

segments.src: Which condition is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: Qual condição é a causa mais provável?

segments.src: - A) Soil pH is too low (strongly acidic)
segments.tr: - A) O pH do solo está muito baixo (fortemente ácido)

segments.src: - B) Soil pH is too high (alkaline)
segments.tr: - B) O pH do solo está muito alto (alcalino)

segments.src: - C) Nitrogen was over-applied
segments.tr: - C) O nitrogênio foi aplicado em excesso

segments.src: - D) The soil has no cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) O solo não tem capacidade de troca catiônica

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Glossário de hoje

segments.src: - **Essential element** — A nutrient a plant cannot complete its life cycle without, and whose role no other element can substitute for; there are 17.
segments.tr: - **Elemento essencial** — Um nutriente sem o qual uma planta não consegue completar seu ciclo de vida, e cujo papel nenhum outro elemento pode substituir; existem 17.

segments.src: - **Macronutrient / Micronutrient** — Classification by the *amount* a plant needs, not by importance; both categories are equally essential.
segments.tr: - **Macronutriente / Micronutriente** — Classificação pela *quantidade* que uma planta precisa, não pela importância; ambas as categorias são igualmente essenciais.

segments.src: - **Guaranteed analysis (N-P-K)** — The three numbers on a fertilizer label giving percent nitrogen, percent phosphate (P₂O₅), and percent potash (K₂O) by weight.
segments.tr: - **Análise garantida (N-P-K)** — Os três números em um rótulo de fertilizante que indicam a porcentagem de nitrogênio, porcentagem de fosfato (P₂O₅) e porcentagem de potássio (K₂O) por peso.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — The acidity or alkalinity of the soil solution on a 0–14 scale; it determines the chemical form, and therefore the availability, of most nutrients.
segments.tr: - **pH do solo** — A acidez ou alcalinidade da solução do solo em uma escala de 0 a 14; determina a forma química e, portanto, a disponibilidade da maioria dos nutrientes.

segments.src: - **Buffering capacity** — A soil's resistance to pH change, supplied by exchangeable acidity held on clay and organic matter; it sets how much lime or sulfur is actually required.
segments.tr: - **Capacidade de tamponamento** — A resistência de um solo à mudança de pH, fornecida pela acidez trocável retida na argila e matéria orgânica; define quanto calcário ou enxofre é realmente necessário.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's total capacity to hold positively charged nutrients on negatively charged clay and organic matter surfaces; a proxy for nutrient-holding ability.
segments.tr: - **Capacidade de troca catiônica (CTC)** — A capacidade total do solo de reter nutrientes carregados positivamente em superfícies de argila e matéria orgânica carregadas negativamente; um indicador da capacidade de retenção de nutrientes.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 → B (10 lb).** The middle number is percent by weight, so 20% of 50 lb = 10 lb of phosphate.
segments.tr: *Resposta: **Q1 → B (10 lb).** O número do meio é a porcentagem por peso, então 20% de 50 lb = 10 lb de fosfato.

segments.src: Note this is P₂O₅, the oxide form used on labels, not elemental phosphorus — elemental P would be about 44% of that figure.*
segments.tr: Observe que este é P₂O₅, a forma de óxido usada nos rótulos, não fósforo elementar — o P elementar seria cerca de 44% desse valor.*

segments.src: ***Q2 → X (False).** Identical pH does not mean identical lime requirement.
segments.tr: ***Q2 → F (Falso).** pH idêntico não significa necessidade de calcário idêntica.

segments.src: A heavy clay soil high in organic matter has a large reserve of exchangeable acidity — high buffering — and may need several times the lime a sandy soil needs to make the same pH move.
segments.tr: Um solo argiloso pesado e rico em matéria orgânica tem uma grande reserva de acidez trocável — alto tamponamento — e pode precisar de várias vezes o calcário que um solo arenoso precisa para fazer a mesma mudança de pH.

segments.src: This is exactly why soil test reports include a buffer pH.*
segments.tr: É exatamente por isso que os relatórios de teste de solo incluem um pH tamponado.*

segments.src: ***Q3 → B.** Iron becomes progressively less soluble as pH rises; in alkaline soil it precipitates into forms roots cannot absorb.
segments.tr: ***Q3 → B.** O ferro torna-se progressivamente menos solúvel à medida que o pH aumenta; em solo alcalino, ele precipita em formas que as raízes não conseguem absorver.

segments.src: The plant is iron-deficient despite iron being physically present — a good illustration that total nutrient content and plant-available nutrient content are two different things.
segments.tr: A planta está com deficiência de ferro apesar de o ferro estar fisicamente presente — uma boa ilustração de que o conteúdo total de nutrientes e o conteúdo de nutrientes disponíveis para a planta são duas coisas diferentes.

segments.src: Interveinal chlorosis on the youngest leaves is the classic symptom, because iron is not readily remobilized within the plant.*
segments.tr: A clorose internerval nas folhas mais jovens é o sintoma clássico, porque o ferro não é facilmente remobilizado dentro da planta.*

in.title: [Pertanian 101 #4] Tanah Anda Adalah Rekening Bank — Beginilah Cara Kerja Setoran dan Penarikannya

segments.src: > Plants need 17 essential elements, but three of them (N, P, K) do most of the heavy lifting — and soil pH quietly decides how much of any of them a root can actually reach.
segments.tr: > Tanaman membutuhkan 17 unsur penting, tetapi tiga di antaranya (N, P, K) melakukan sebagian besar pekerjaan berat — dan pH tanah secara diam-diam menentukan seberapa banyak unsur tersebut yang sebenarnya dapat dijangkau oleh akar.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Think of soil as a checking account that plants draw from every day.
segments.tr: Anggaplah tanah sebagai rekening giro yang ditarik oleh tanaman setiap hari.

segments.src: Plants build themselves out of **essential elements** — nutrients that, if missing, mean the plant literally cannot complete its life cycle.
segments.tr: Tanaman membangun dirinya dari **unsur-unsur penting** — nutrisi yang, jika tidak ada, berarti tanaman secara harfiah tidak dapat menyelesaikan siklus hidupnya.

segments.src: There are 17 of them.
segments.tr: Ada 17 unsur tersebut.

segments.src: Three come free from air and water: carbon, hydrogen, oxygen.
segments.tr: Tiga di antaranya diperoleh secara gratis dari udara dan air: karbon, hidrogen, oksigen.

segments.src: The other 14 come from the soil.
segments.tr: 14 sisanya berasal dari tanah.

segments.src: Those 14 split into two groups by *quantity needed*, not importance:
segments.tr: 14 unsur tersebut terbagi menjadi dua kelompok berdasarkan *jumlah yang dibutuhkan*, bukan kepentingannya:

segments.src: - **Macronutrients** (needed in large amounts): nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), plus calcium, magnesium, and sulfur.
segments.tr: - **Makronutrien** (dibutuhkan dalam jumlah besar): nitrogen (N), fosfor (P), kalium (K), ditambah kalsium, magnesium, dan belerang.

segments.src: - **Micronutrients** (needed in trace amounts): iron, manganese, zinc, copper, boron, molybdenum, chlorine, nickel.
segments.tr: - **Mikronutrien** (dibutuhkan dalam jumlah sedikit): besi, mangan, seng, tembaga, boron, molibdenum, klorin, nikel.

segments.src: A micronutrient deficiency will kill a crop just as dead as a nitrogen shortage.
segments.tr: Kekurangan mikronutrien akan mematikan tanaman sama seperti kekurangan nitrogen.

segments.src: The difference is how much you have to add.
segments.tr: Perbedaannya terletak pada seberapa banyak yang harus Anda tambahkan.

segments.src: **The Big Three.** Every bag of fertilizer in the U.S.
segments.tr: **Tiga Besar.** Setiap kantong pupuk di AS

segments.src: carries three numbers on the front — say, `10-10-10`.
segments.tr: memiliki tiga angka di bagian depan — misalnya, `10-10-10`.

segments.src: That's the guaranteed analysis: percent nitrogen, percent phosphate (P₂O₅), percent potash (K₂O), by weight.
segments.tr: Itu adalah analisis terjamin: persentase nitrogen, persentase fosfat (P₂O₅), persentase kalium (K₂O), berdasarkan berat.

segments.src: A 50 lb bag of 10-10-10 contains 5 lb of N, 5 lb of phosphate, and 5 lb of potash.
segments.tr: Satu kantong 50 pon (sekitar 22,7 kg) 10-10-10 mengandung 5 pon N, 5 pon fosfat, dan 5 pon kalium.

segments.src: The rest is carrier and filler.
segments.tr: Sisanya adalah pembawa dan pengisi.

segments.src: Roughly what each does:
segments.tr: Secara kasar fungsi masing-masing:

segments.src: - **Nitrogen** — leaves and stems, chlorophyll, protein. Deficiency shows as pale yellowing on the *oldest* leaves first, because the plant scavenges N from old tissue and moves it to new growth.
segments.tr: - **Nitrogen** — daun dan batang, klorofil, protein. Kekurangan terlihat sebagai warna kuning pucat pada daun *tertua* terlebih dahulu, karena tanaman mengambil N dari jaringan lama dan memindahkannya ke pertumbuhan baru.

segments.src: - **Phosphorus** — roots, energy transfer, flowering and seed set. Deficiency can show as dull purple-tinged leaves.
segments.tr: - **Fosfor** — akar, transfer energi, pembungaan dan pembentukan biji. Kekurangan dapat terlihat sebagai daun yang kusam dengan semburat ungu.

segments.src: - **Potassium** — water regulation, stomatal control, disease resistance, stalk strength. Deficiency often shows as scorched leaf margins.
segments.tr: - **Kalium** — pengaturan air, kontrol stomata, ketahanan terhadap penyakit, kekuatan batang. Kekurangan sering terlihat sebagai tepi daun yang hangus.

segments.src: **Now the part most people skip: pH.**
segments.tr: **Sekarang bagian yang paling sering dilewati orang: pH.**

segments.src: Soil pH is a measure of how acidic or alkaline the soil solution is, on a 0–14 scale where 7 is neutral.
segments.tr: pH tanah adalah ukuran seberapa asam atau basa larutan tanah, pada skala 0–14 di mana 7 adalah netral.

segments.src: It matters because **pH controls nutrient availability**.
segments.tr: Hal ini penting karena **pH mengontrol ketersediaan nutrisi**.

segments.src: You can have plenty of phosphorus in the soil and still starve the crop, because at low pH the phosphorus binds with iron and aluminum into forms roots can't take up.
segments.tr: Anda bisa memiliki banyak fosfor di dalam tanah namun tetap membuat tanaman kelaparan, karena pada pH rendah fosfor berikatan dengan besi dan aluminium menjadi bentuk yang tidak dapat diserap oleh akar.

segments.src: At high pH it binds with calcium instead.
segments.tr: Pada pH tinggi, fosfor justru berikatan dengan kalsium.

segments.src: Phosphorus is most available roughly between pH 6.0 and 7.0 — which is why most field crops and garden vegetables are happiest in the pH 6.0–7.0 window.
segments.tr: Fosfor paling tersedia kira-kira antara pH 6,0 dan 7,0 — itulah sebabnya sebagian besar tanaman ladang dan sayuran kebun paling subur pada kisaran pH 6,0–7,0.

segments.src: Iron, manganese, and zinc run the opposite way: they get *more* available as soil turns acidic.
segments.tr: Besi, mangan, dan seng bekerja sebaliknya: mereka menjadi *lebih* tersedia saat tanah menjadi asam.

segments.src: That's why azaleas and blueberries — acid-lovers — go chlorotic and yellow in alkaline soil.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya azalea dan blueberry — tanaman penyuka asam — menjadi klorotik dan kuning di tanah basa.

segments.src: They can't get iron.
segments.tr: Mereka tidak bisa mendapatkan zat besi.

segments.src: **Buffering capacity** is why fixing pH is harder than it sounds.
segments.tr: **Kapasitas penyangga (buffering capacity)** adalah alasan mengapa memperbaiki pH lebih sulit daripada kedengarannya.

segments.src: If you add acid to distilled water, the pH plunges.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menambahkan asam ke air suling, pH akan turun drastis.

segments.src: Add the same acid to soil and it barely moves.
segments.tr: Tambahkan asam yang sama ke tanah dan pH hampir tidak berubah.

segments.src: That resistance is buffering, and it comes from the soil's reserve of exchangeable acidity sitting on clay particles and organic matter — a large hidden pool that keeps refilling the soil solution as you neutralize it.
segments.tr: Resistensi itu adalah penyanggaan, dan itu berasal dari cadangan keasaman tanah yang dapat dipertukarkan yang tersimpan pada partikel tanah liat dan bahan organik — kumpulan besar tersembunyi yang terus mengisi kembali larutan tanah saat Anda menetralkannya.

segments.src: Practical consequence: a heavy clay soil rich in organic matter needs *far more* lime to raise its pH one unit than a sandy soil does.
segments.tr: Konsekuensi praktis: tanah liat berat yang kaya bahan organik membutuhkan *jauh lebih banyak* kapur untuk menaikkan pH-nya satu unit dibandingkan tanah berpasir.

segments.src: That's why a soil test doesn't just report pH — it reports a **buffer pH** or **lime requirement**, which is the number that actually tells you how much lime to spread.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya uji tanah tidak hanya melaporkan pH — tetapi melaporkan **pH penyangga** atau **kebutuhan kapur**, yang merupakan angka yang sebenarnya memberi tahu Anda berapa banyak kapur yang harus disebar.

segments.src: Soil test pH   -> where you are now
segments.tr: Soil test pH   -> where you are now

segments.src: Buffer pH      -> how hard it will be to move
segments.tr: Buffer pH      -> how hard it will be to move

segments.src: Lime rate      -> tons per acre to get where you want
segments.tr: Lime rate      -> tons per acre to get where you want

segments.src: The general rules of thumb: **lime** (calcium carbonate) raises pH; **elemental sulfur** lowers it.
segments.tr: Aturan praktis umum: **kapur** (kalsium karbonat) menaikkan pH; **belerang unsur** menurunkannya.

segments.src: Both work slowly — months, sometimes a full season — because they depend on soil moisture, temperature, and microbial activity.
segments.tr: Keduanya bekerja lambat — berbulan-bulan, terkadang satu musim penuh — karena bergantung pada kelembapan tanah, suhu, dan aktivitas mikroba.

segments.src: One more piece of vocabulary that ties it together: **cation exchange capacity (CEC)**.
segments.tr: Satu kosakata lagi yang menyatukan semuanya: **kapasitas tukar kation (CEC)**.

segments.src: Clay and organic matter carry negative charges, and positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — stick to those sites like magnets on a fridge.
segments.tr: Tanah liat dan bahan organik membawa muatan negatif, dan nutrisi bermuatan positif — kalsium, magnesium, kalium, amonium — menempel pada situs tersebut seperti magnet di kulkas.

segments.src: High CEC means a soil holds a large nutrient reserve and buffers strongly.
segments.tr: CEC tinggi berarti tanah memiliki cadangan nutrisi yang besar dan menyangga dengan kuat.

segments.src: Low CEC (sandy soil) means nutrients leach through fast.
segments.tr: CEC rendah (tanah berpasir) berarti nutrisi cepat tercuci.

segments.src: Same fertilizer, very different behavior.
segments.tr: Pupuk yang sama, perilaku yang sangat berbeda.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Say you're in Ohio and you plant tomatoes in the same backyard bed for the third summer running.
segments.tr: Katakanlah Anda berada di Ohio dan Anda menanam tomat di bedengan halaman belakang yang sama selama tiga musim panas berturut-turut.

segments.src: You fertilize religiously with a high-nitrogen lawn-style product because it's what's in the garage.
segments.tr: Anda memupuk dengan rajin menggunakan produk gaya rumput tinggi nitrogen karena itulah yang ada di garasi.

segments.src: You get magnificent, dark green, four-foot vines — and almost no fruit.
segments.tr: Anda mendapatkan tanaman merambat setinggi empat kaki yang megah dan hijau tua — dan hampir tidak ada buahnya.

segments.src: That's textbook nutrient imbalance.
segments.tr: Itu adalah contoh ketidakseimbangan nutrisi dalam buku teks.

segments.src: Excess nitrogen pushes vegetative growth at the expense of flowering and fruit set.
segments.tr: Kelebihan nitrogen mendorong pertumbuhan vegetatif dengan mengorbankan pembungaan dan pembentukan buah.

segments.src: Meanwhile, three seasons of removing tomatoes has been quietly withdrawing potassium and phosphorus from the account with no matching deposit.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, tiga musim memanen tomat telah diam-diam menarik kalium dan fosfor dari rekening tanpa setoran yang sepadan.

segments.src: And in much of the eastern U.S., where rainfall gradually leaches calcium and magnesium out of the topsoil, the pH has been drifting downward year over year — possibly into the mid-5s, where phosphorus availability drops sharply.
segments.tr: Dan di sebagian besar wilayah timur AS, di mana curah hujan secara bertahap mencuci kalsium dan magnesium dari lapisan atas tanah, pH telah bergeser ke bawah dari tahun ke tahun — mungkin ke pertengahan 5, di mana ketersediaan fosfor turun drastis.

segments.src: The fix costs less than a bag of fertilizer.
segments.tr: Perbaikannya memakan biaya lebih murah daripada sekantong pupuk.

segments.src: Nearly every state has a land-grant university extension service — Ohio State, Penn State, NC State, Texas A&M — running soil testing labs, typically in the $15–$25 range per sample.
segments.tr: Hampir setiap negara bagian memiliki layanan penyuluhan universitas hibah tanah — Ohio State, Penn State, NC State, Texas A&M — yang menjalankan laboratorium pengujian tanah, biasanya dalam kisaran $15–$25 per sampel.

segments.src: You send in a composite of 10–15 cores from around the bed.
segments.tr: Anda mengirimkan komposit 10–15 inti tanah dari sekitar bedengan.

segments.src: What comes back is pH, buffer pH, extractable P and K, calcium, magnesium, organic matter percentage, and CEC, plus a recommendation in pounds per 1,000 square feet.
segments.tr: Hasil yang kembali adalah pH, pH penyangga, P dan K yang dapat diekstraksi, kalsium, magnesium, persentase bahan organik, dan CEC, ditambah rekomendasi dalam pon per 1.000 kaki persegi.

segments.src: If the report says pH 5.4 with a lime requirement of 50 lb per 1,000 sq ft, spreading that lime the previous fall will do more for next year's tomatoes than any amount of fertilizer applied in June.
segments.tr: Jika laporan menyatakan pH 5,4 dengan kebutuhan kapur 50 pon per 1.000 kaki persegi, menyebarkan kapur tersebut pada musim gugur sebelumnya akan lebih bermanfaat bagi tomat tahun depan daripada jumlah pupuk apa pun yang diaplikasikan pada bulan Juni.

segments.src: You're not adding nutrients — you're unlocking the ones already sitting there.
segments.tr: Anda tidak menambahkan nutrisi — Anda membuka kunci nutrisi yang sudah ada di sana.

segments.src: There's an environmental side too.
segments.tr: Ada sisi lingkungan juga.

segments.src: Nutrients you apply beyond what the crop can use don't vanish.
segments.tr: Nutrisi yang Anda aplikasikan melebihi apa yang dapat digunakan tanaman tidak akan hilang.

segments.src: Nitrate leaches into groundwater; phosphorus runs off into surface water and feeds algal blooms.
segments.tr: Nitrat tercuci ke air tanah; fosfor mengalir ke air permukaan dan memicu ledakan alga.

segments.src: The recurring summer blooms in Lake Erie and the hypoxic "dead zone" in the Gulf of Mexico are both driven substantially by nutrient runoff from a very large watershed.
segments.tr: Ledakan alga musim panas yang berulang di Danau Erie dan "zona mati" hipoksia di Teluk Meksiko sebagian besar didorong oleh limpasan nutrisi dari daerah aliran sungai yang sangat luas.

segments.src: Matching the rate to the actual soil test is the single cheapest thing that helps both your yield and the water downstream.
segments.tr: Menyesuaikan tingkat pemupukan dengan hasil uji tanah yang sebenarnya adalah hal termurah yang membantu hasil panen Anda dan air di hilir.

segments.src: The professional framing for this is the **4Rs**: Right source, Right rate, Right time, Right place.
segments.tr: Istilah profesional untuk ini adalah **4R**: Right source (Sumber yang tepat), Right rate (Tingkat yang tepat), Right time (Waktu yang tepat), Right place (Tempat yang tepat).

segments.src: Pick the fertilizer form that fits, apply only what the test calls for, put it down when the crop can use it, and place it where roots will find it.
segments.tr: Pilih bentuk pupuk yang sesuai, aplikasikan hanya sesuai kebutuhan hasil tes, berikan saat tanaman dapat menggunakannya, dan tempatkan di tempat akar akan menemukannya.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3 Poin Utama

segments.src: 1. Plants need 17 essential elements; N, P, and K are needed in the largest amounts, which is why every fertilizer bag carries three numbers (`N-P₂O₅-K₂O`) on the front.
segments.tr: 1. Tanaman membutuhkan 17 unsur penting; N, P, dan K dibutuhkan dalam jumlah terbesar, itulah sebabnya setiap kantong pupuk memiliki tiga angka (`N-P₂O₅-K₂O`) di bagian depan.

segments.src: 2. Soil pH governs whether nutrients are chemically *available* to roots — phosphorus peaks around pH 6.0–7.0, while iron and zinc become more available as soil turns acidic.
segments.tr: 2. pH tanah mengatur apakah nutrisi secara kimiawi *tersedia* bagi akar — fosfor memuncak di sekitar pH 6,0–7,0, sementara besi dan seng menjadi lebih tersedia saat tanah menjadi asam.

segments.src: 3. Buffering capacity, driven by clay and organic matter, resists pH change — so a soil test's buffer pH, not the pH alone, tells you how much lime to apply.
segments.tr: 3. Kapasitas penyangga, yang didorong oleh tanah liat dan bahan organik, menahan perubahan pH — jadi pH penyangga dalam uji tanah, bukan pH saja, memberi tahu Anda berapa banyak kapur yang harus diaplikasikan.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **Q1.** A 50 lb bag of fertilizer is labeled `10-20-10`.
segments.tr: **Q1.** Sekantong pupuk 50 pon diberi label `10-20-10`.

segments.src: How many pounds of actual phosphate (P₂O₅) does it contain?
segments.tr: Berapa pon fosfat (P₂O₅) sebenarnya yang dikandungnya?

segments.src: - A) 5 lb
segments.tr: - A) 5 pon

segments.src: - B) 10 lb
segments.tr: - B) 10 pon

segments.src: - C) 20 lb
segments.tr: - C) 20 pon

segments.src: - D) 50 lb
segments.tr: - D) 50 pon

segments.src: **Q2.** O/X — Two soils both test at pH 5.5, so they will both need the same amount of lime to reach pH 6.5.
segments.tr: **Q2.** O/X — Dua tanah keduanya diuji pada pH 5,5, jadi keduanya akan membutuhkan jumlah kapur yang sama untuk mencapai pH 6,5.

segments.src: **Q3.** A gardener's soil has plenty of iron in it, but the plants show yellowing between the leaf veins (chlorosis).
segments.tr: **Q3.** Tanah seorang tukang kebun memiliki banyak zat besi di dalamnya, tetapi tanaman menunjukkan warna kuning di antara urat daun (klorosis).

segments.src: Which condition is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: Kondisi mana yang paling mungkin menjadi penyebabnya?

segments.src: - A) Soil pH is too low (strongly acidic)
segments.tr: - A) pH tanah terlalu rendah (sangat asam)

segments.src: - B) Soil pH is too high (alkaline)
segments.tr: - B) pH tanah terlalu tinggi (basa)

segments.src: - C) Nitrogen was over-applied
segments.tr: - C) Nitrogen diaplikasikan berlebihan

segments.src: - D) The soil has no cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) Tanah tidak memiliki kapasitas tukar kation

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Kosakata Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Essential element** — A nutrient a plant cannot complete its life cycle without, and whose role no other element can substitute for; there are 17.
segments.tr: - **Unsur penting (Essential element)** — Nutrisi yang tanpanya tanaman tidak dapat menyelesaikan siklus hidupnya, dan yang perannya tidak dapat digantikan oleh unsur lain; ada 17 unsur.

segments.src: - **Macronutrient / Micronutrient** — Classification by the *amount* a plant needs, not by importance; both categories are equally essential.
segments.tr: - **Makronutrien / Mikronutrien** — Klasifikasi berdasarkan *jumlah* yang dibutuhkan tanaman, bukan berdasarkan kepentingannya; kedua kategori sama-sama penting.

segments.src: - **Guaranteed analysis (N-P-K)** — The three numbers on a fertilizer label giving percent nitrogen, percent phosphate (P₂O₅), and percent potash (K₂O) by weight.
segments.tr: - **Analisis terjamin (N-P-K)** — Tiga angka pada label pupuk yang memberikan persentase nitrogen, persentase fosfat (P₂O₅), dan persentase kalium (K₂O) berdasarkan berat.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — The acidity or alkalinity of the soil solution on a 0–14 scale; it determines the chemical form, and therefore the availability, of most nutrients.
segments.tr: - **pH tanah** — Keasaman atau kebasaan larutan tanah pada skala 0–14; ini menentukan bentuk kimia, dan dengan demikian ketersediaan, sebagian besar nutrisi.

segments.src: - **Buffering capacity** — A soil's resistance to pH change, supplied by exchangeable acidity held on clay and organic matter; it sets how much lime or sulfur is actually required.
segments.tr: - **Kapasitas penyangga (Buffering capacity)** — Ketahanan tanah terhadap perubahan pH, yang disediakan oleh keasaman yang dapat dipertukarkan yang tertahan pada tanah liat dan bahan organik; ini menentukan berapa banyak kapur atau belerang yang sebenarnya diperlukan.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's total capacity to hold positively charged nutrients on negatively charged clay and organic matter surfaces; a proxy for nutrient-holding ability.
segments.tr: - **Kapasitas tukar kation (CEC)** — Kapasitas total tanah untuk menahan nutrisi bermuatan positif pada permukaan tanah liat dan bahan organik yang bermuatan negatif; proksi untuk kemampuan menahan nutrisi.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 → B (10 lb).** The middle number is percent by weight, so 20% of 50 lb = 10 lb of phosphate.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **Q1 → B (10 pon).** Angka tengah adalah persentase berdasarkan berat, jadi 20% dari 50 pon = 10 pon fosfat.

segments.src: Note this is P₂O₅, the oxide form used on labels, not elemental phosphorus — elemental P would be about 44% of that figure.*
segments.tr: Perhatikan bahwa ini adalah P₂O₅, bentuk oksida yang digunakan pada label, bukan fosfor unsur — fosfor unsur akan menjadi sekitar 44% dari angka tersebut.*

segments.src: ***Q2 → X (False).** Identical pH does not mean identical lime requirement.
segments.tr: ***Q2 → X (Salah).** pH yang identik tidak berarti kebutuhan kapur yang identik.

segments.src: A heavy clay soil high in organic matter has a large reserve of exchangeable acidity — high buffering — and may need several times the lime a sandy soil needs to make the same pH move.
segments.tr: Tanah liat berat yang kaya bahan organik memiliki cadangan keasaman yang dapat dipertukarkan yang besar — penyanggaan tinggi — dan mungkin membutuhkan beberapa kali lipat kapur yang dibutuhkan tanah berpasir untuk membuat perubahan pH yang sama.

segments.src: This is exactly why soil test reports include a buffer pH.*
segments.tr: Inilah tepatnya mengapa laporan uji tanah menyertakan pH penyangga.*

segments.src: ***Q3 → B.** Iron becomes progressively less soluble as pH rises; in alkaline soil it precipitates into forms roots cannot absorb.
segments.tr: ***Q3 → B.** Zat besi menjadi semakin kurang larut seiring naiknya pH; di tanah basa, zat besi mengendap menjadi bentuk yang tidak dapat diserap akar.

segments.src: The plant is iron-deficient despite iron being physically present — a good illustration that total nutrient content and plant-available nutrient content are two different things.
segments.tr: Tanaman kekurangan zat besi meskipun zat besi secara fisik ada — ilustrasi yang baik bahwa kandungan nutrisi total dan kandungan nutrisi yang tersedia bagi tanaman adalah dua hal yang berbeda.

segments.src: Interveinal chlorosis on the youngest leaves is the classic symptom, because iron is not readily remobilized within the plant.*
segments.tr: Klorosis antar urat pada daun termuda adalah gejala klasik, karena zat besi tidak mudah dimobilisasi kembali di dalam tanaman.*
